caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a pitcher or jug, centrally placed on a plain, off-white background. The vessel is gray in color with shading to suggest a metallic texture, possibly pewter. The jug has a wide, round base that tapers slightly upward in a conical manner and is accented with raised bands near the base and the top. The spout is ornate, with a wavy, scalloped shape, and the handle is angular and attached from the upper neck to the midsection of the vessel. The handle also appears to be metallic and matches the body in texture and color. There is a small signature reading "Richard Taylor" located in the lower right section of the drawing. No additional objects or decorative elements are present in the image, and the composition is minimalistic, with the entire focus on the jug.
title: Enamel Pitcher
